1. $p(w_1,\ldots,w_T)=\prod_{t=1}^{T}p(w_t\mid w_{1:t-1})$.
2. Cross-entropy / negative log-likelihood of the true next token.
3. Self-attention (weighted combination of other positions’ values).
4. Finetuning updates weights on a dataset; prompting only changes the input context.
5. Hallucination (confident false statements), among others.
